title: Release-quality bug-fix and polish pass on the preview build
problem: A play-through of the preview (commit 897e581) found misleading game state, out-of-sync counters, ambiguous Rush and results words, a Skip that passes through live controls, a reward that flickers, unclear Sprint and League messages, and journey, animation and sound rough edges.
scope: Fix the eight preview findings: wholesale looks sold out while rivals buy; purchase counters out of step; stocking counts one fruit twice; Rush words; Skip to the end; Sprint stamps flicker; Sprint same-start and twist words; League trophy and star words
Journey polish: Home and menus (Continue labels, Back and cancel, fullscreen prompt), one clear action per phase, freshness labels, results and progression
Animation and sound audit: lorry, buying and stocking, Bell, Rush, stars and rewards; Fast and Reduced motion; mute persists; no stale effects after background, resume or skip
Regression tests for every confirmed bug; full verification list run where this machine can
exclusions: No rule, balance, protocol or save-format change; the Sprint perk choice stays and is explained (a messaging fix)
No publishing to the live game without the owner's separate word
Art stays: cards, portraits, fruit, lorry, crates, shutters

acceptance.evidence: npm run verify on the merged branch: 1263 passed, 1 skipped (as before)
PORT=8890 E2E_MINUTES=15 npm run test:e2e on the merged build: E2E OK; online leaks 0 and 0; one phone 3 hand-overs; six stalls; reconnect 5 cycles

acceptance.text: Each of the eight findings reproduced before and checked fixed after, with screens
acceptance.evidence: REP-138 section 1 and img/REP-138: findings 1-3 and 5-8 reproduced before and fixed after; finding 4 partly reproduced (the doubled line only for screen readers) and fixed

acceptance.text: Play-throughs: guided sale, Normal computer game, League clear and retry, Daily, three-day Sprint with reload, One phone hand-over
acceptance.evidence: Browser run: guided first sale and full solo game, League clear, short stage, One phone, Sprint; extra: six stalls at 360x640 with Skip (4 runs), Daily at 1280x800 with reduced motion, Sprint reload, League Retry after a loss. Real phones NOT RUN

acceptance.text: The owner sees it on the preview
acceptance.evidence: The owner reviewed it on the preview and asked to publish (2026-11-24)
